title: Half the researched SegmentCost values don't survive primary sources (8 of 16)
summary: Of 16 SegmentCost cells researched in this cohort, 6 could not be sourced at all and 2 are contradicted by primary sources — several by 10x+ (P0196 Gulf Crossing: sheet $121M vs Boardwalk's own 10-Ks at $1.4-1.8bn; P0373 Corpus Christi: sheet $500M vs Cheniere's $375-398M capitalized; P0290 Nueva Era: sheet $500M vs $353.4M financed; P0257: TC Energy's own page and Mexico's federal project database both ~US$2.1bn; P1297: sheet's $200M looks like total project cost vs PGJ's $94M for construction). NOT a tracker-wide defect — SegmentCost is 53.3% referenced tracker-wide, BETTER than Capacity's 42.7%, and this cohort's 5.3% is largely selection effect (rows chosen for being stale). The claim is narrow: among stale rows, a cost value checked against primary sources fails about half the time. Do NOT blank the 6 unsourceable ones — undisclosed is not wrong.

title: StartState/Province: P2636 Wildcat still reads Texas, but its origin was traced to Oklahoma
summary: P2636 Wildcat Gas Pipeline (SheetRow 1362) reads Texas to Texas, but its origin was traced to Grady County, Oklahoma (flagged by one agent, not confirmed). P2613 Sierrita was fixed to Arizona on 2026-10-14 and the column audit is done (notes/audit-2026-09-04-us-gas-startstate-column.md). The remaining mismatches in that audit need a source to settle and are left for later.
